sloka: ततः तु तारा व्यसन अर्णव प्लुतामृतस्या भर्तुर् वदनम् समीक्ष्य सा ।जगाम भूमिम् परिरभ्य वालिनम्महा द्रुमम् छिन्नम् इव आश्रिता लता ॥४-२२-३२॥
transliteration: tataḥ tu tārā vyasana arṇava plutāmṛtasyā bhartur vadanam samīkṣya sā ।jagāma bhūmim parirabhya vālinammahā drumam chinnam iva āśritā latā ॥4-22-32॥

translations.english: Then Tara, plunged in an ocean of calamity, gazed upon the face of her dead lord, and embracing Vali sank to the ground, as a creeper clings to a great tree that has been felled.
